dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: Don't tell me... That guy Pakaa moved my records to the children's section again!

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: Ah, he's the one at Xochicuicatl Records.

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: Have you been? Although Pakaa isn't the most reliable guy, he's got good taste, and they even carry some of my records.

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: There are tracks that you can listen to for free. Don't miss out!

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: ...Oh and, please let me know what you think after you've listened to it. Like... does my music really sound like it's meant for children?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've not heard. What do other people say?

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Well, everyone agrees. That's why Pakaa keeps moving my records from the popular section to the children's section.

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: Really, shouldn't a musician have the right to say what genre of music their work is supposed to be?

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: Besides, if you really think about it, I'm Pakaa's uncle! That brat, no respect for his elders...

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: Ah well, there's no point continuing to be mad at him. He rarely listens to what I have to say, but at least he's got a knack for running a store.
